description: Keep a file in the asset library this key reaches (personal, or the team's shared library for a team key) until it is deleted, and return its spicy://a/<id> uri for later model inputs made with keys of the same workspace. Give exactly one source: taskId (an output of one of the user's own successful tasks, or of the team's with a team key; index or key picks which, the first output by default), path (an absolute path to a file on this computer, uploaded first), url (a public http or https file), or fileId (a committed spicy://f/ upload). Saving the same task output, upload or URL again returns the existing asset. Storage unlocks with lifetime top-ups; a refusal carries a reason (asset_library_locked, asset_library_full, asset_file_too_large, asset_daily_limit, asset_storage_full) — call spicyapi_assets_usage_get to explain the plan rather than retrying.

contentType.description: With path: only when the file extension is missing or wrong.

fileId.description: A committed upload: fil_… or spicy://f/…

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the key from an uncertain earlier attempt to replay that save. Not used with path, which uploads again on every call.

index.description: With taskId: zero-based position in output.assets.

key.description: With taskId: the output key, instead of index.

name.description: Up to 80 characters; a path defaults to its file name.

path.description: Absolute path to a file on this computer, as the user gave it.

name: spicyapi_asset_save

favorite.description: Favorite mark of the library; in a team library everyone sees the same ones.

model.description: Public name of the model that generated the asset; empty for uploads and links.

modelName.description: Display name of that model; may be empty.

previewUrl.description: Private preview signed for at most 20 minutes; empty when signing failed. Never store or share it; keep uri instead.

uri.description: Stable spicy://a/<id> reference. Put it in any media field of a model input; it works until the asset is deleted and only in requests made with keys of the same workspace.

title: Save a file to the SpicyAPI asset library
